definition: Loab ( LOBE) is a fictional character that artist and writer Steph Maj Swanson claimed to have discovered with a text-to-image AI model in April 2022.
details: In a viral Twitter thread, Swanson described the images of Loab as an unexpectedly emergent property of the software, saying they discovered them when asking the model to produce something "as different from the prompt as possible".

explainer.lead: Loab is a fictional character that artist Steph Maj Swanson claimed to have found with a text-to-image AI model in April 2022. It matters as a widely discussed case of an apparently emergent, unsettling output from generative image software.

tiers.eli5: An artist said a strange face kept appearing in AI-generated pictures, and the story went viral as if the AI had invented a character.
tiers.practitioner: It is cited in discussion of text-to-image model behaviour and emergent outputs rather than as a tool; claims about it are artistic and anecdotal, not a technical result.
tiers.paperLevel: No formal definition applies; it is a documented anecdote from April 2022 describing images Swanson said emerged when prompting the model for something as different from the prompt as possible.

explainer.example: Swanson reported producing images of Loab by asking a text-to-image model for outputs as different from the prompt as possible, then shared them in a viral Twitter thread.
